journey.title: Find out why a target cannot be proven, and fix it
journey.purpose: The diagnostic loop, and the one that decides whether this scenario is trustworthy. An operator sees a target that is not passing and must reach the specific missing capability — and its remedy — without reading source code or falling back to the CLI. Every unavailable state in the system is a promise that this journey terminates somewhere actionable.

steps.intent: Notice that a target is not passing, and read its disposition without needing colour to tell unavailable from unsupported.
Read the specific missing capability — hardware acceleration — rather than a generic failure.
See a second, differently-caused unavailability and confirm it names a different next action.
Confirm a remote target whose host node is offline stays listed and carries the reachability reason rather than disappearing.

claims.statement: Every unavailable disposition reachable in this journey names both the missing capability and a next action the operator can take.
claims.rationale: S2A-P0-003. This is the load-bearing promise of the whole disposition model. An unavailable state with no remedy is indistinguishable from a bug.

claims.statement: Two targets unavailable for different reasons display different missing capabilities and different next actions.
claims.rationale: A single generic 'unavailable' message across distinct causes is the failure mode this journey is designed to catch.

claims.statement: A target whose host node is offline remains present in the inventory with its reason.
claims.rationale: A disappearing target reads as a configuration change rather than a temporary outage, and sends the operator looking in the wrong place.

claims.statement: The journey completes without leaving the operator surface.
claims.rationale: The CLI is the complete control surface for agents; the UI must be complete for diagnosis, or the matrix is only a status light.
